The supreme prince of the Spirit Realm was tragically murdered after being plotted against, and reborn into the mortal world as a lowly servant! Possessing an unparalleled creation elixir and heaven-defying cultivation techniques, he overturns the entire martial arts world with only a rusty sword. 

His dual martial souls awaken simultaneously, refining all spirits and comprehending the dual paths of divine soul cultivation. He traverses the Heavenly Demon Treasury, the Dragon Transformation Realm, and ancient ruins, acquiring supreme treasures such as the Demon Lord Armor and the Great Desolate Mirror. 

Various prodigies, sect parasites, and extraterrestrial evil races come to his death, but he crushes them all with a single sword strike! He subdues a dragon soul and a spirit dog, protects his beloved friends and family, surpasses Martial Kings, breaks through Martial Emperors, and ascends to Martial Venerable status.
